name: Cornwall Site Allocations Development Plan Document

housing-numbers.notes: This is an appendix of main modifications to site allocations. Individual site allocations are listed with dwelling numbers (e.g., PZ-H8: 350 dwellings, PZ-H9: 197 dwellings, etc.) but overall housing targets are not provided in this modifications document. References to plan period ending in 2030 and mentions Cornwall Local Plan Strategic Policies as the parent document containing overall targets.
